subject.title: [Feature]: Control console session list should show full date

question: Should the Sessions Updated column switch from relative recency text to a full local date/time display, with relative time kept only as optional hover context?
rationale: The requested behavior is a user-facing UI preference change rather than a broken documented contract, and the existing implementation candidate is stale and conflicting.

options.title: Adopt full date/time
options.body: Review, rebase, or replace the linked candidate with a narrow current-main Control UI change and focused tests.

options.title: Keep relative timestamps
options.body: Close the linked implementation path and document that the Sessions table intentionally prioritizes recency text.

recommendation.title: Adopt full date/time
recommendation.body: Review, rebase, or replace the linked candidate with a narrow current-main Control UI change and focused tests.

likelyOwner.reason: Peter owns the most recent current-main Sessions view changes and is the clearest routing candidate for the Control UI display decision.
